generateQuestions.promptDescription:
The {'{'}data{'}'} placeholder in the prompt is replaced with the paragraph content and sent to the AI model.
The AI model generates related questions from the paragraph. Put each generated question in <question></question> tags so the system can link it automatically.
Results depend on the selected model and prompt. Adjust them as needed for the best results.
